# Genus-one fibrations on rational surfaces

## Lattice preliminaries

::: {.definition #def:lattice}
A lattice is a projective module of finite rank over the base ring equipped
with a nondegenerate symmetric bilinear form, not assumed definite or
unimodular.
:::

::: {.theorem #thm:torelli title="Torelli for rational elliptic surfaces"}
The period map for marked rational elliptic surfaces is injective on the
complement of the discriminant divisor of the fibration.
:::

This file lives in another project root, so its targets are visible in the
